title: How many digits?
hints: Dividing an `int` by 10 chops off its last digit: `2026 / 10` is `202`. Count how many times you can do that before the number runs out.

Use a `while` loop that keeps dividing by 10. Careful with `0`: it has one digit, but a loop that runs `while (n != 0)` would never start. One fix: begin with 1 digit and loop `while (n / 10 != 0)`. Negative numbers need no special case, because C's division truncates towards zero.
`int digits = 1; while (n / 10 != 0) { n /= 10; digits++; } return digits;`
